sources.summary: Furniture company IKEA has launched the limited-edition Konstrunda collection, an assortment of furniture and homeware objects that reimagine collectible design from the likes of Andu Masebo at an affordable price point. Konstrunda, or Art Tour, consists of 22 pieces by seven designers, including work from Masebo, Italian designer Emanuele Stamuli and Swedish talents like Lisa Hilland, The post IKEA launches collectible design objects "at a price that people can afford" appeared first on Dezeen .
